title: The Role of The Governor In Kingdom Administration
paragraphs: We will focus on the purpose of the gifts of the Spirit and the fruit of the Spirit. The purpose of talent or talents, in the plural, and the fruit of the spirit, in the singular. First, let me clarify a few things. I want to start this session with a question. It's a very tricky question. It's a trap question. Here's the question. What would life be like if humans had never fallen? I want you to think about this question. I don't want an answer now.

But I want you to think about it because it's a real and legitimate question. What would life be like if humans had never sinned, if Adam had never sinned? First and foremost, it is clear that there will still be a planet like the one we have today. It is clear that there will still be humans on it, just as we have today. It is clear that there will be billions of people on the planet. So, the second question is, what would they do if the human hadn't fallen? Just think about it.

The first command God gave to Adam may have been a hint at one of the questions. It is found in Genesis, chapter 2, verse 15. It says that the Lord God took man and put him in the Garden of Eden and commanded him, and the first command was: work. Let everyone say: Work. Let everyone say: Work. This is important. Work is not a sign of a curse. God established work before man sinned. So work is not the curse. Work is the first commandment from God. Which means that work is the reason you were created.

God did not command man to sing or to clap. God did not command man to pray. In fact, none of these things are found in the first and second chapters of Genesis. However, these are the only chapters in the Bible where we find these words where the Lord says that this is very good. In these chapters there is no command to gather, hold meetings, or worship. God never told us to do that. God said to Adam: Work. Therefore, anything we do now is not God's original plan for our lives.

The focus here is on the word "original". In other words, these religious practices that you are doing, you are going through them, or you grew up with them, whether you are here in the Bahamas or the Caribbean, or you are in America watching this program, or in Canada, or England, and people are watching us in Africa, and South Africa, I know you are watching. You know, wherever you are, all this religion, whether it be Hinduism, Buddhism, Confucianism, or Christianity, God never intended any of it.

God did not expect or intend for us to come together and sing songs. This is not something that falls within God's mandate in the Book of Genesis. God never expected us to gather and try to gain His presence through acts of worship. These are serious issues. Let me take the question further. If man had never fallen, would there still have been a need for messengers, prophets, evangelists, pastors, and teachers? These people are not mentioned anywhere in the first and second chapters of Genesis.

There is no mention of any messenger, prophet, evangelist, shepherd, or teacher. Why? Because all of these are necessary only because of the fall. Therefore, the things we call great tasks are actually the product of the fall. If man had never fallen, there would have been no need for Calvary, no need for resurrection, no need for church meetings, no need for apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, teachers, hosts, helpers, musicians—there would have been no need for any of them.

Based on the biblical text, it seems that God will eventually get rid of them as well. In fact, it was God who spoke through Paul and said: Tongues will cease, and prophecies will cease. You will no longer need anyone to teach you. That will be in your heart. In other words, God will get rid of everything you were trying to get. Yes. Yes. Some of you can't wait to become a shepherd. God will get rid of that. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Why? Because this entire program that we are now engaged in was not God's original plan.

Now why am I starting such an argument? Because I want you to understand that God's original plan was never, and still is not, a religion. God's plan is very clearly defined by God himself. It is found in Genesis, chapter 1, verse 26. God said: Let us make mankind in our image, after our likeness, and let them rule over what? On the fish of the sea, and on the birds of the sky, and on the beasts, and on all the earth, and on everything that moves on the earth.

Therefore, verse 26, the Lord God created man in his own image, creating him male and female. Verse 27: And God blessed them and said, “ Be fruitful and rule over all the earth.” a point. a point. a point. No singing, no dancing, no prayers, no fasting, nothing. Control only. The word for domination is the Hebrew word and it is the same word for kingdom. So, the mission that God gave to humanity was a kingdom. Let everyone say kingdom. Please write the word "kingdom". We will talk about that.

A kingdom is a government ruled by a king. The kingdom has nothing to do with religion. It is a governing political concept. It is under the rule of a king. This is very important. Point number one. Therefore, the first thing God gave to mankind was government. Government responsibility on the ground. In fact, the word domination means to rule, to control, to manage, to lead, and to have authority over. It's an amazing word. It means controlling the environment. It means resource management.

This is what the king does. The king rules his kingdom. So the task that God gave to man was an administrative task. Therefore, we can understand how kingdoms work. All kingdoms expand themselves through a system called colonialism. By the way, is my item on the board? I am facing some problems. Can you switch, please? Help me, Mikey. Thank you very much. It is very important to understand that the kingdom expands or extends through a process called colonialism.

Colonialism is when a kingdom rules a territory far from it through a system called colonialism. Colonialism is when a king takes some of his citizens and places them in a foreign land and makes that land exactly like his kingdom. This is called colonialism. Point number three is very important, which is that the kingdom delegates the administration of its government in the colony to a person called a governor.

So when a kingdom takes over a territory and wants to rule it, it places delegated authority in that territory through a person whom the king calls a governor. In the Bahamas, for those of you old enough to know this, when I was born in 1954, the Bahamas was under the rule of a kingdom. We were under the rule of a kingdom for almost 200 years as a country. In fact, we are not a country. We were what they call a colony.

In the Bahamas, during my upbringing, there was one man in this country who was the ruler of this country. He lived in a house not far from here. That house was called the Governor's Palace. You probably all know where that house is located. It has a large pink fence. It occupies an entire square created and built by England, surrounded by that pink wall and containing a huge house called the Governor's Palace. A person from England was sent to live in that house.

The reason they were sent there was that they came from the Queen's court to live in the Bahamas to ensure that the Bahamas would become just like England. That is the purpose of the ruler's existence. The governor is sent by the king to the colony to live there, and he has been given delegated powers to manage the king’s wishes in the colony. Is this clear? Are you sure? Good.

The fourth point then becomes crucial, which is that the ruler is authorized by the king to delegate powers and tasks to whomever he wishes. In other words, when the ruler coming from England lived in the Bahamas, the Queen and King of England did not choose the local officials. Instead, they left that to the ruler. Therefore, the governor of the Bahamas appointed people from the local administrative staff and gave them powers to manage the king's wishes under his authority.

When a governor comes to a colony, he comes only to carry out the will of the king or queen. That's why he comes. When he delegates authority to anyone, he gives that power only to carry out the will he received from the king, which means that everyone essentially works for the king’s will. So in England, when they said we should drive on the left side of the road like they do, then the governor tells everyone you must drive on the left side of the road.

So he gave instructions to all the authorities in the country he had appointed, whether it was the police chief or the traffic chief, whoever it was, telling them now everyone must drive on the left. They said, "Put up signs." He made sure they implemented everything and they had to complete managing that, and now we drive on the left to look just like England. That is the power of the government's mandate. Which leads us to point four. These delegated powers are solely for the purpose of the Kingdom.

In other words, when a ruler appoints someone and gives them authority and the ability to act, they can only use that in the service of the kingdom. They could not use it for personal gain. They could not use it to enhance their own ego or reputation. They had to use it for the purpose of strengthening the kingdom only because it was not their authority. They were granted it by delegation from the governor. Is this clear? Every kingdom operates in this way.

Remember that in the days of Jesus, Jesus was born under the rule of a kingdom, and God had indeed made sure that he was born under a kingdom so that all the components and models would be present. This is why it took 4,000 years for Jesus to come to Earth, because there was no empire before the Roman Empire that had established a kingdom similar to the kingdom of God.

So God waited until the exact model was in place, and then the Bible says in Galatians chapter 3 that in the fullness of time God sent his Son, born of a woman, at just the right time. Why did God wait for 4000 years? Because he had to wait until the system on Earth became similar to the system of the Kingdom in Heaven. Even when Jesus spoke, everyone understood his words because the concepts were there. Is this clear? Now, if you study the Roman Empire, you will find that Caesar was the king and he lived in Italy.

Italy is far from Palestine in the Mediterranean Sea, as you know, on the western side. Thus, you find that when Rome controlled all of Europe, it controlled the entire Middle East. They ruled everything. Jesus Christ was born in a small town in the Roman Empire, far from Caesar. Caesar was the king. But in the region where Christ was born, it was called a colony. The colony was called Palestine. King Caesar sent a governor to that region whose name was Pilate.

Pilate's job was to make sure that the entire region acted, thought, spoke, and lived exactly like Rome. That's why you hear the saying: "When in Rome, do as the Romans do." It was a serious policy. If you are in Roman territory, act like a Roman. That's what it means. Eat like the Romans, dress like the Romans, and speak like the Romans. You were speaking Latin. In fact, this is why Latin later became such a powerful element in the Church, because Rome ruled the world and made all religious activities in Latin.

Because Latin is a Roman language. It is not a divine language. And so Christ was born in the midst of a kingdom that looked exactly like his own. Caesar's job, or rather Pilate's job, was simply to carry out Caesar's will in that region. Pilate's job was to turn Palestine into Rome. Therefore, the delegated powers he received were solely for Rome. He could not use it to build his own kingdom. In fact, any ruler who acted and began to act as if he were the king was to be killed.

The ruler only says what the king orders him to say. He does nothing except what the king commands him to do. It was a complete extension of the king. Therefore, these delegated powers were called privileges or gifts, gifts of the king. Now, when you talk about delegated powers, they had to be gifts because delegation means that you do not own them. That's why it's called a gift. It is a gift. You didn't earn it. You didn't work for it. She is a commissioner.

That is why when you speak of the Holy Spirit, the ruler, He comes to the territory with gifts. They are called gifts of the Spirit. These are delegated capabilities that he brings with him to grant to those he chooses in the region to carry out administrative work for the kingdom. These are the governor's gifts. Let everyone speak of the ruler's gifts. The governor's gifts. Say it out loud. The governor's gifts. The governor's gifts. Therefore, the entire concept of the gifts of the Spirit is related to this term.

I want you to get used to it. The administration of the kingdom is not related to religion. It does not concern itself with mysterious matters. It's not about falling to the ground, rolling around, screaming, or all those things we do. It's about management. It is a government job. Every spiritual gift that the Holy Spirit gives you as a person is a gift that is governmentally authorized for governmental work. It's not meant to make you feel good. Not to give you excitement.

It's not meant to make you run around and do funny things. Rather, it is granted to you for an activity that promotes the government's interests in the region. Amen. Amen. This is extremely important. Therefore, the gifts of the Spirit are for the administration of the kingdom. Let me, let me say it this way. The governor is responsible for the governmental administration in the colony. This is the case for all government rulers in the kingdom.

Now, if you are from America, this may not seem logical to you, because rulers in republics, and especially federal ones, differ in those concepts. In fact, the governor of each state in America is independent of the president. Actually, let me put it this way. The United States, for example, is a conglomeration of nations. Each state is a country, and that is why it is called a nation. It is a state. A state is a nation. The leader of that state is called the governor. So the United States has 54 governors.

I get 54, how many states? Fifty. So they have 50 governors. Why? Because every state is a country. Florida is a country. Atlanta is a country. Sorry, Georgia is a country. The president of that country is the ruler. Therefore, the governor does not receive instructions from the president. He is an independent person chosen by the people of that small state that is considered a country. The President of the United States does not appoint governors. They are elected by the people of the state.

They are the heads of state. For this reason, even if Washington makes some decisions regarding laws, the state can disagree with them. That's why you could have a governor in California, for example, who chooses to allow lesbians or gay men their rights, you know, they can get married in the state, while another state would be different, because they are different countries. Do you understand this? So the president has no influence over the rulers in that republic.

However, the ruler of the kingdom is the exact opposite. First and foremost, the governor is appointed by the king, and all he can do is what the king dictates to him. For this reason, the ruler must address the king with the title "Lord". The word "master" means owner. Do you remember when Pilate was talking to the people and Christ was beside him, and they were trying to crucify Jesus, that is, demanding his life, and the discussion was, how can you let him go? Pilate says: I find no fault in this man.

You have a personal problem with him, and I don't. They said: You must crucify him. He says: I will not, because I do not find anything legally wrong with it. Then people said something that terrified him. They said: If you do not crucify him, we will send a message to Caesar stating that you are allowing two things. First, you are allowing another king to be in the area. Oh, this is betrayal. Secondly, we have no master but Caesar.

When Pilate heard these two phrases, although he hated to do so, for this reason he washed his hands. He realized that his political life was in danger. Because you see, a ruler can never oppose the king in the kingdom. He does, says, and acts only according to the king's will and instructions. Is this clear? Yes. Good. Now you understand some of the things Jesus said about the Holy Spirit. The Holy Spirit is the ruler of God’s kingdom who was placed in the colony of the earth to make the earth resemble heaven.

Christ says that when he comes, he will not speak on his own. He will only say what I tell him, and he will not seek his own glory, but the glory of the King, Jesus Christ. Yes. You can never make the Holy Spirit disagree with Jesus. Don't even try. He is the ruler. He is located in the Earth colony to transform the Earth into Heaven. That is why he says that the spirit knows how to pray, that is, the will of God. Then he says, “This is God’s will, and how we pray for it.” He said, "Pray like this."

Our Father, who art in heaven, where are you? In the heavens. That is the host country. Hallowed be Thy name. He said, “Pray now, that the effect of your kingdom may come and your will be done. Here it is, let it be done. Where?” On the ground. how? As it is in heaven. He says your first prayer should be that the earth becomes like heaven. a point. That's why the ruler is here. When you do that, God should answer your prayer. There is one prayer that God must answer when you pray it.

Therefore, every time you pray, you should always pray that one prayer. Do not pray for food, clothing, or anything else. Pray, O God, that your kingdom may come and your will be done today, this Monday morning, and on Tuesday, and on Wednesday, all day long, in my work, in my family, in my home, and in my body. May your judgment come, and may your influence come in my school, in my college, in my life, in my thinking, in my work, and in my investments.

Then God begins to rule in those areas and the Kingdom comes into your life. It's not about religion. I want you to get this idea out of your head. It is not a religion. It's a government. Write this down. Therefore, the apprenticeship is the distribution and delegation of powers by the ruler to citizens whom he selects to carry out the work of government in the colony. If you don't understand that phrase, you won't understand the Bible and you'll make it a religious book.

The talents that the ruler brings are delegated powers that he distributes as he pleases to whomever he pleases for the purpose of carrying out the administrative activities of the kingdom on earth. For this reason, the gifts are given by the Ruler, the Holy Spirit. This is extremely important. This third point, then, is extremely important. This means that talents are granted by the ruler as the ruler decides. This is extremely important. You cannot tell the governor what gift you want.

The Bible says, and I will read from it shortly, that He gives gifts as He pleases to whomever He pleases. Therefore, you may not like the person who received that gift, but that is none of your business. So why, why did God bless her? Because the ruler has absolute powers. In the Bahamas, when the governor ruled us under the English crown, he could appoint anyone as prime minister. He could appoint anyone as his permanent secretary. It was the governor's responsibility, obligation, and right to appoint.

The fact that the governor in the colony enjoys full powers is really interesting. Actually, here's something very strange. You will understand this now. In the Kingdom, and we still have remnants of that in the Bahamas. That is why we are still debating whether the ruler should represent the queen, because you see, in the kingdom, you face this problem. The problem is that the king or queen is the supreme authority.

So, under the Kingdom of Great Britain when we were subject to it, if the ruler chose you to give you a knighthood or the Order of the British Empire (OBE), which I did receive from the Queen, then it was done locally first. In other words, the ruler in the society, in the colony, says: I will award you the OBE. Then the governor would send your name to England, and it was actually said "upon the governor's recommendation".

Now, once the ruler recommends someone, and this is a profound matter, the king and queen automatically agree. This is a profound matter. This means that once the Holy Spirit says you are well, Christ says you are well. Praise God for the sake of the Holy Spirit. The Holy Spirit says, “You are forgiven, my brother,” and Heaven says, “You are forgiven.” If the Holy Spirit says, "Bless it," Lord, have mercy on us. The sky says, “Gather all these good things and pour them on him.” Why?

Because the ruler recommends blessing. That is why the Bible says that the Holy Spirit gives gifts to whomever He wills; it does not refer back to Christ on that point. He is the one who gives recommendations to Christ. Why? Because the Holy Spirit dwells in the colony and knows your life. Oh, you missed that. Therefore, you cannot bypass the ruler and speak to Christ about this matter. No, no, I've been watching you all day. I live inside you. You are not good enough yet. You cannot get an upgrade yet.

If the ruler promotes you, then you have become a promoted person. Yes, sir. This is why many people think they can get away with their actions in secret. The ruler lives with you every day in your dark, secret moments. You ask God to bless you, and the ruler says I live with that. Do not bless that. You have some problems and are still trying to work out some conditions. That is why he, the ruler, rebukes you for sin. Not Jesus. The governor rebukes you. Because he lives in the colony.

He knows where you lack experience, where you are weak, and where you struggle, and he works on that. He says, "Look, you must fix this aspect before God uses you for the next level." He lives in the colony. Where is Christ? He is in heaven, sitting at the right hand of the Father, interceding for you. But where is the Holy Spirit? It's right in the heart of the place, in the middle of the chaos where you are. He knows everything about you. You cannot fool Jesus.

The Bible says that the Spirit knows the depths of God and reveals them to you and to Him. It is very important to understand that talents are given by government privilege. This is the next point, number four. Talents are only for the service of the government. Please write this down. This is very important. Look, many people these days are using talents for their own development and personal prosperity. People are selling prophecies, man.

You know, if you listen, if the government gives you a government vehicle, let me take a deep breath before I finish this sentence. If the government gives you a vehicle with a red license plate, does it belong to you? no. So if the government sees you on a Sunday with your ten children in the back of that truck going for a walk, they can literally stop you and make everyone get out. Why? It is not for your own personal enjoyment. And so it is with all the government's talents.

When God gives you a gift through the Holy Spirit, it is not for your own personal benefit. It is a government job. Thus we have miracle makers who sell miracles. We have people who have prophecies and tongues who sell prophecies to people. Call me now, send me $10 and I will give you a prophecy. If you have a problem in your life, just call me and pay $100 and I will make a prediction for you. I have seen this. I was in meetings where I vomited. I vomited spiritually. I couldn't believe they were doing that.

These are well-known people whom you sometimes pursue. Watch who you follow. These are illegal people who steal government talent. Misuse of government gifts. Healing talents, and the sale of healing services. And healing is real, as you know. It's a gift. But they use it for personal prosperity. Every gift from the government is for the benefit of the government. Therefore, every time you use a gift of the Spirit, it should be to promote the kingdom of God, not your own kingdom.

Let's talk about the gifts of the soul. 1 Corinthians 12 says: “Regarding spiritual gifts, brothers and sisters, I do not want you to be uninformed.” Paul says: I do not want you to use these gifts without understanding. The ruler comes to Earth to give you delegated powers. He says that you must understand it and you must learn about it. Look at the following verse. Ephesians 1:13 says: “In him you also were, having heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation.”

"By believing, you were sealed in him with the promised Holy Spirit, who is the pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of what is to be possessed, to the praise of his glory." What this simply means is that God placed the ruler on Earth as a guarantee of the existence of a king. If you have never seen the king, the proof of his existence is the presence of the governor as a token in the colony.

Listen, when I was a child in this country, we were required to sing to the Queen and King of England every morning, every morning at school. We were wearing those shorts, long socks, and a little bow tie, man, we were standing in the scorching sun, 95 degrees, I mean scorching sun, and we were four years old. May God protect our generous queen, may our noble queen live long. May God protect our queen. Born to rule us, bright and glorious, born to rule us. May God protect the Queen.

And we used to sing it, man, with all our hearts. Every morning we worshipped them, yet we never saw them. This is important. You don't need to see him to worship him. People say to me, how can you believe in a God you cannot see? How did you make me sing for a queen I have never seen? The only evidence we have of England's existence is that of that white man from England who smokes a pipe and walks around our island speaking English. He was the proof that a queen existed somewhere. Oh, hallelujah.

The ruler was the guarantor that ensured the existence of a legacy for a kingdom somewhere. As soon as there is a ruler, there is a kingdom. Shout "Amen", people. Paul says that when you receive salvation, you have believed and you have been sealed. Here it is. How was it concluded? With a deposit. You don't need Jesus. The governor is sufficient. Therefore, when you receive Jesus Christ and His words, you receive the Ruler to live within you. That is a sign in the colony that the king is alive and well.

Hallelujah. Ten roles for the ruler. Write this down quickly. The ten roles that the ruler plays, and you will now see how they work. First, the governor is appointed by the king. Secondly, it comes only from the Kingdom. This is important. That's important. Let me pause here for a moment. Look, the ruler of any kingdom never comes from the colony. There was no ruler from the Bahamas as long as we were under the Kingdom of Great Britain. Because the ruler never comes from the colony. Do you know why?

Because no one from the colony can change the colony. If the colony is to be transformed into a kingdom, no one in it can transform it because they do not know what a kingdom is like. Therefore, the governor must be sent from the kingdom to the colony. That is why Christ says: When I leave, I will send you another Comforter who will guide you. He will teach you. He will train you. Why? He says he comes from my father, from the kingdom. Praise God because the ruler is coming from the kingdom. Thank God.

That is why the Holy Spirit is called a "Holy Spirit," because there is no Holy Spirit on earth. He came to make us holy, just as our Father in heaven is holy. It only comes from the Kingdom. Third, he represents only the king. The ruler of the kingdom represents only the king. He does not represent himself. Jesus said that the Holy Spirit would not speak any words of his own accord. He will only tell you what I tell him. Fourth, the ruler only expresses the thoughts and will of the king.

The ruler does not speak his own mind. In our country, when the Governor of England lived here for those two hundred years, everything the Governor said was exactly what the King had ordered him to say to us in the colony. He was unable to give us his own thoughts. He was unable to give us his intentions or his own point of view. He had to keep saying: In the name of the king, in the name of the king, in the name of the king. Why? What am I speaking on behalf of the king?

In fact, even when he received the instructions for the year for our colony, it was called a message from the throne. We still use this term because we are still under the colony, you know, the Commonwealth. Although we are independent, we still have the Queen. Therefore, even the Prime Minister has to submit his plans to the Governor. The ruler must read it and deliver the message from the throne because we are still under the Commonwealth. When the Holy Spirit speaks, it is Jesus speaking.

This is a good place to say Amen. You missed out. That is why in the Book of Revelation, Christ was speaking to the church, but listen to how he said it. He says, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Although he, in the colony, speaks through the governor. You know, let me say something that was very complicated and very confusing to me when I was a young boy. I couldn't understand how people could pray to Jesus. Even today, I still don't understand that. We are not actually supposed to pray to Jesus.

Christ never told us to pray to him. Read your Bible carefully. John 16, John 17 to 18 are very carefully specific instructions. He said, “When you pray, pray to the Father.” That is the government. In my name, that is the power. And the Holy Spirit will deliver it. Because what? The Holy Spirit knows the will of God. He knows the mindset of the government. So if you don't know how to pray, pray in the Spirit, the Holy Spirit, and you will be praying with the mind of God.

That's why your prayers will be answered automatically. This is why praying in tongues is so important. When you pray in tongues, you cannot make a mistake. When you pray in an understandable language, you are likely making your own suggestions to God. This is why many of our prayers go unanswered. We come to God in all kinds of ways, asking you to bless us, O God. What do you mean by "blessed"? I put Shadrach in this mess to make her mature. Don't tell me to park and take her out. Oh, no.

I mean, imagine if Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego were your shepherds and you heard that they were put in prison in Türkiye, in some other country over there, and they sent a message saying we are about to enter a fiery furnace. O church, pray. Now what will you pray for? Look, that's the problem. What will you pray for? I know what you will pray for. You will pray for whatever is on your mind. Oh God, save them. Oh God, put out this fire. Oh God, destroy the king. We have reached a point of deep prayer.

We will never pray: O God, take them to You and enter with them. We never call for this. However, this was God's will. He would take them into the fire to be with them, and no one would be burned. This is something you would never pray for, but this is prayer in the Spirit. Chapter 8 of 1 Corinthians, yes, 1 Corinthians 8, says that there are times when you do not know what you should pray for.

He said, “When that happens, pray in the Spirit with unspoken expressions in the Holy Spirit, because the Holy Spirit knows the mind of God.” Do n't you speak in tongues? It's better for you to get that. Praying in tongues is safe because the Spirit speaks to Jesus and the Father. You can't be wrong. Hallelujah. Without this. The ruler is responsible for transforming the colony into a kingdom. That is why the Holy Spirit is here. The Holy Spirit is not here to take you to heaven. Let me repeat this.

The Holy Spirit is on earth not to take you to heaven. Because if that was his goal, he would have killed you a long time ago. The fastest way to leave. He is here to change your behavior and culture. He is here to make the earth like heaven, not to take the earth to heaven. Your will be done on earth as it is in heaven. That is his job. So he is here to transform us into citizens of the kingdom while we are on the ground. Number five.

The role of the ruler is to transmit the kingdom’s culture, values, morals, nature, language, and way of life to the colony. I think the Bible has been so grossly misunderstood that we have literally created something that God knows nothing about, and it is called religion. What God wanted was a community and a culture, not a religion or an exclusive group or what we call the church. He wanted a culture for a society that would be embodied in a people. That is why God made Israel.

He did not make Israel a church or a religion. Rather, He made them a nation. He told them that people would know the difference between them and themselves because of the god they worshipped and the way they lived. What are we doing? We build our buildings, we put up colored glass so that no one can see us, we ring a bell so that everyone knows that the time of coming has come, and we hide behind these walls and perform some rituals. God forbid that this should be the intention.

Christ said, “Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works.” When they see them, they will give credit and glory to God and say that these must be from somewhere else. correct. This is correct. That's what he meant. But instead of showing ourselves to the world, we hide in these places called church buildings. We have something resembling a secret society called Christianity. What a tragedy. Number seven. The government, the ruler, prepares subjects for citizenship.
